work.title: Frontend Developer / Mobile App Developer
work.description: Building and maintaining the MiWay Blink app across web, Android, and iOS. Own frontend delivery with Vue/Nuxt and backend integration with Oracle/PHP, plus native permission flows and device integrations.
bullets: Architected a dynamic maintenance mode on Miway Blink using Firebase Realtime Database, enabling on-the-fly activation with no user-side refresh.
Led Android (9-13) and iOS (Swift, iPhone 13+) permissions flow development using Java, Swift, and JavaScript plugins.
Shipped the Miway Blink referral feature end-to-end — Vue.js/Nuxt frontend, Oracle/PHP backend — letting clients refer others and earn cashback.
Won 'Best Innovative Idea' at the 2023 MiWay Hackathon for an AI/OCR feature that reads car number plates, odometers, and license discs from user photos.
Built a Nuxt middleware layer for route management (disabling, redirects, scheduling) driven by Firebase, and integrated Huawei (HMS) push notifications and redirection logic.
Placed runner-up at the 2025 MiWay Hackathon.

Architected and developed a telematics plugin enabling telematics providers to be added to the mobile app, building the Java and iOS implementations and integrating it into the MiWay Self-Service app.
Build and maintain the MiWay website on Nuxt 3 and Prismic, continuously shipping new slices and functionality against business requirements.

Architected and developed Miduty, a Nuxt 3/Laravel POC for managing production duty rotation across 8 teams, with Azure AD SSO, Jira AI-summarized standup prep, and automated leave-conflict/stand-in handling.

work.title: Full Stack Engineer
work.description: Full stack development across the company's public site, internal intranet (CHIRON), and blog, built on Symfony/PHP.
bullets: Upgraded the company website from Symfony 2.2 to Symfony 3 and made all pages/tables mobile responsive.
Built voucher management functionality on the intranet, replacing manual production-database edits with an auditable, permissioned workflow for customer care agents.
Created a store foot-count management system for Store Managers to log and report data on a daily/weekly/monthly basis.
Developed an employee data collection system for POPI Act compliance, letting staff self-update their details with HR export/edit access.
Rebuilt the company blog off WordPress 3, adding a new UI, social sharing, booking integration, Mailchimp, and Google Analytics.

work.title: Web Developer
work.description: Built responsive websites for provident/pension fund clients on a custom PHP CMS (Siteworx), plus custom tooling and client support.
bullets: Developed a geolocation service for the USN (South Africa) website.
Built a custom drag-and-drop email creator with Backbone.js, HTML, and a PHP backend, with cross-device send/test previews.
Added responsive design to the core of the Siteworx custom CMS and built marketing sites for client branding.
Supported the electronic board pack product by training clients and handling day-to-day queries.

highlights: 400+ hours on the freeCodeCamp front-end developer certification
